title: Noise commutes with taking the odd part
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $ho\in[-1,1]$, and let $f$ be a bounded real-valued function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube. The odd part of the noise of $f$ with parameter $ho$ equals the noise with parameter $ho$ of the odd part of $f$.
hypotheses_covered: f is a bounded real-valued function on the n-dimensional sign cube
